# INT Terminal

![INT Terminal function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/diagram/numeric-terminals/lecture/int32.svg)

[Numeric functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Creates a signed 32-bit integer (I32) control on the Front Panel and its linked diagram terminal.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Terminal INT**

Cree une commande entiere signee sur 32 bits (I32) sur la face-avant et son terminal lie sur le diagramme. [Types] Sans opérande de fonction ; type de l’instance : entier (I32 par défaut). Constantes/contrôles fournissent une valeur, indicateurs la reçoivent.

</details>

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **editor managed**. This is an editor-managed element; placement and configured values are distinct from an executable function provider.

The element is created and managed by the Studio editor rather than executed as a function provider.

No function operand; instance type: integer (default I32). Constants/controls supply a value; indicators consume it.
